title: Trump Vs. Biden: Tech Policy
summary: On The Ben & Marc Show, Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz compare Trump and Biden policies on tech, crypto, AI and startup taxes, framed around their 'Little Tech Agenda'. They also discuss the Trump assassination attempt.
why: HN cites it as the source for how Andreessen and Horowitz explain their political shift toward the Republicans.
